demarcation.SOURCE_CLAIMED_OFFICIAL: Upstream URL claimed as official but document lacks independent cryptographic signature or certificate chain.
demarcation.SOURCE_AUTHENTICITY_VERIFIED: Document bytes cryptographically verified against official publisher signing key or government public key infrastructure.
demarcation.SOURCE_THIRD_PARTY_REJECTED: Secondary aggregator or unofficial vendor feed.

security_invariants: User-entered URLs or filenames never constitute proof of source authenticity.
Unauthenticated evidence is automatically quarantined in data/prospective/evidence_vault/quarantine/.
Quarantined evidence cannot satisfy official schedule verification preconditions.
